meta.name: competitor-analysis
meta.description: Analyze competitors with strengths, weaknesses, and differentiation opportunities. Identifies direct competitors and maps the competitive landscape. Use when doing competitive research, preparing a competitive brief, or finding differentiation opportunities.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析竞品优劣势，发现差异化机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做竞品研究或寻找市场定位
copy.tagline_en: Analyze competitors' strengths and weaknesses to find differentiation opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing competitive research or seeking market positioning

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你指定的产品或公司，找出 5 个直接竞争对手，评估它们的优势、劣势和差异化机会，并输出一份完整的竞争分析报告。
howto.when: 当你要求进行竞争研究、准备竞争简报或寻找差异化机会时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下我们公司的新产品在市场上的竞争对手。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出 5 个直接竞品。

say.text: 对比我的产品和竞品 A 的优劣势。
say.note: Claude 会输出详细的对比分析。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will analyze your specified product or company, identify 5 direct competitors, assess their strengths, weaknesses, and differentiation opportunities, and output a comprehensive competitive analysis report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for competitive research, preparing a competitive brief, or finding differentiation opportunities.

say_en.text: Analyze the competitors for our company's new product in the market.
say_en.note: Claude will search and list 5 direct competitors.

say_en.text: Compare my product with competitor A's strengths and weaknesses.
say_en.note: Claude will output a detailed comparison.
